specName: Point the agent at shared knowledge from AGENTS.md
last_action: 17/17 tasks done; validator 17/17, sync suite 229/229, reference 31/31, smoke passed; fresh-chat SCs not run

FR-001.title: After a sync that writes the index, root AGENTS.md has one knowledge section with extension-unique markers

FR-002.title: Section tells the agent to read the index first, open listed files, cite <label> › <path>; suggest sync when the index, a listed source entry or a file is missing

FR-003.title: Section lists enabled source labels and tells the agent to use only their index entries

FR-004.title: Section is at most 12 lines plus one per label

FR-005.title: Sync creates AGENTS.md when absent, with only the section

FR-006.title: Every byte outside the section is unchanged

FR-007.title: No write when the section would be identical

FR-008.title: No timestamps, counts, absolute paths or source content in the section

FR-009.title: Section removed in the same run sync deletes the index

FR-010.title: Config option turns the behavior off (default on); off removes an existing section

FR-011.title: Damaged or duplicated markers: file unchanged, warning with the fix

FR-012.title: AGENTS.md read/write failure is a warning, never changes sync result or exit code

FR-013.title: Labels are escaped literals that cannot end the section or inject instructions

FR-014.title: Sync and remove reports say created / updated / unchanged / removed for AGENTS.md

FR-015.title: remove, --disable and --enable re-derive the section from enabled sources (or drop it when none), same rules as sync, only when the index exists

FR-016.title: remove never modifies knowledge-index.md; sync stays its only writer

expectations: configure or remove writing the section
context: area: commands/speckit.knowledge.sync.md (index write/delete lifecycle, completion report, config validation)
area: knowledge-config.yml schema 1.1 (new optional opt-out key)
constraint: remove never touches knowledge-index.md; sync owns its lifecycle
constraint: agent-context extension owns the SPECKIT START/END block in AGENTS.md; never touch it
constraint: 1.8.1 default exclusions keep a source repo AGENTS.md out of caches
intent: sync keeps a brief AGENTS.md section that sends the agent to knowledge-index.md for questions about other repos or configured sources

decisions.decision: remove/--disable/--enable update only the AGENTS.md section (option A); supersedes the earlier non-goal "remove writing the section". The index stays sync-only; the section restricts the agent to enabled sources, hiding stale entries until the next sync.
Opt-out key agents_md (top-level boolean, default true); invalid value leaves AGENTS.md untouched
decisions.why: the default writes a committed file; a typo like agents_md: no must not be overridden
decisions.rejected: max_items precedent of treating an invalid value as unconfigured; name agent_context (collides with the agent-context extension)

decisions.why: optional additive key, every 1.1 file stays valid (005 precedent)

decisions.decision: Markers <!-- KNOWLEDGE START --> / <!-- KNOWLEDGE END -->, whole-line match; damaged = anything but exactly one of each, start before end
decisions.why: mirrors agent-context SPECKIT markers; label lines start with '- ' so they can never close the section

decisions.decision: One procedure, § Agent Context Section in sync.md; remove applies it by reference (step 3a)
decisions.why: a second copy would drift and rule 11 guards only the validation block
decisions.rejected: duplicating the procedure in remove.md; a shared script (forbidden by §I/§III)

decisions.decision: Append at end with one blank line; replace in place; remove drops the block plus the blank line above it; delete the file if only whitespace remains
decisions.rejected: inserting near the top of AGENTS.md

decisions.decision: Sync leaves the section alone when no index exists and none was deleted (offline first sync)
decisions.why: AGENTS.md is committed but the index is git-ignored; removing it on a teammate's fresh clone causes churn; FR-002 covers the missing-index case
decisions.rejected: remove the section whenever no index exists

decisions.decision: The persisted section names the sync command by canonical id speckit.knowledge.sync, not the __SPECKIT_COMMAND_KNOWLEDGE_SYNC__ token
decisions.why: the token renders per host at install, so teammates on different hosts would commit different bytes (FR-007)

decisions.decision: configure step 4 preserves every other top-level key on edits
decisions.why: otherwise a rewrite could drop agents_md: false (and the max_* keys)

decisions.decision: A whitespace-only AGENTS.md is treated like a missing one (write replaces it with the section)
decisions.why: the literal append rule left leading blank lines; found by the reference run

decisions.decision: Write-then-remove neutrality documented with one exception: a final line feed added to a file that lacked one
decisions.why: making it fully neutral would need state about what write added; the reference run showed the claim was false as written

decisions.decision: remove step 3 also preserves every top-level key
decisions.why: same exposure as configure step 4; remove rewrites the config too

plan.summary: Plan: one § Agent Context Section in sync.md, applied at sync 1a/8b and remove 3a; agents_md opt-out; contracts for the exact section text, config key and report lines; quickstart walkthrough
plan.key_finding: The section must be host-neutral and must not be removed when no index exists, because AGENTS.md is committed while the index is git-ignored
